$comment: Change monitoring of the legal library (scripts/kb-monitor.mjs, workflow kb-monitor). Tiers say how often an act should be checked once a schedule is enabled; the workflow has NO schedule until the owner confirms operating limits. 'intensive' lists acts with known pending or frequent amendments.

intensive.description: Acts under revision or amended often: weights and dimensions (revision proposal COM(2023) 445), driving licences (new directive adopted), road charging, dangerous goods annexes, eFTI delegated and implementing acts.
